first 20 of the fixed 36 octets of the golden PING header (tcId 1) with none of the remainder buffered; a decoder MUST NOT parse a short header and MUST report an error rather than a partial/zero-filled result. BRIDGE_REQUEST (MCP tools/call): envelope + SafetyLabel(non_idempotent_write) + foreign JSON verbatim
BRIDGE_RESPONSE echoes the request correlation_id; no SafetyLabel on a reply
BRIDGE_ERROR carries the foreign protocol's own JSON-RPC error object verbatim (never reduced to text)
BRIDGE_NOTIFY (A2A) MUST set corr_len=0; one-way, no reply
BRIDGE_STREAM_DATA with a reserved flag bit (0x02) set: receiver MUST ignore it; final stays false
BRIDGE_STREAM_END sets the final flag (0x01) and carries an empty foreign message

BRIDGE_REQUEST (NLIP 0x06, STREAM/WebSocket JSON-fallback binding): envelope + SafetyLabel(non_idempotent_write, the ECMA-431 POST/stream-open floor, 70_map_nlip.md §7) + an ECMA-430 NLIP message object carried verbatim; NLIP has no method namespace (§4.1), so method_len=0
BRIDGE_RESPONSE (NLIP 0x06) echoes the request correlation_id; no SafetyLabel on a reply

BRIDGE_REQUEST (ANP 0x07, Class OPAQUE JSON-LD): envelope + SafetyLabel(non_idempotent_write, 63_map_anp.md §7 'meta-protocol negotiation' row) + a did:wba-identified negotiation request carried verbatim
BRIDGE_RESPONSE (ANP 0x07) echoes the request correlation_id and method; no SafetyLabel on a reply
BRIDGE_REQUEST (AGNTCY 0x08, ACP over Class OPAQUE): envelope + SafetyLabel(non_idempotent_write, 6f_map_agntcy.md §7 'ACP create a run' row) + a `POST /runs` JSON body carried verbatim
BRIDGE_RESPONSE (AGNTCY 0x08) echoes the request correlation_id and method; no SafetyLabel on a reply

BRIDGE_REQUEST (AP2 0x09, standalone Mandate carriage): envelope, content_type=0x04 (OpaqueContentType TLV; no dedicated SD-JWT value exists, 65_map_ap2.md §3) + a Checkout Mandate SD-JWT carried octet-for-octet; serving a Mandate document is read_only (65_map_ap2.md §4.1), so no SafetyLabel; AP2 defines no operation-method namespace, so method_len=0
BRIDGE_RESPONSE (AP2 0x09) echoes the request correlation_id and carries a Payment Mandate SD-JWT octet-for-octet; read_only, no SafetyLabel

BRIDGE_REQUEST (x402 0x0A, native HTTP binding): envelope, content_type=0x02 (deterministic-CBOR HTTP-Carriage Object per NPAMP-CC-HTTP §4.1/§4.2 -- x402's sole registered carriage) + a plain GET carrying no payment header; read_only (71_map_x402.md §6), so no SafetyLabel

BRIDGE_RESPONSE (x402 0x0A) carries the `402 Payment Required` challenge as a deterministic-CBOR HTTP-Carriage Object (status=402, a base64-encoded PaymentRequired object in the lowercase `payment-required` header per HTTP-Carriage §4.4); read_only (71_map_x402.md §6), so no SafetyLabel
